question.question: Which circulating biomarkers best predict remaining healthspan under lifespan-extending interventions?
question.operationalization: Rank biomarkers by out-of-sample AUROC ≥ 0.7 for remaining healthspan across ≥2 intervention classes with pre-registered endpoints.
question.why_it_matters: Longevity trials need transferable interim endpoints.

hits.title: A review of aging and longevity in model organisms
hits.abstract_snippet: Aging research covers many pathways. Future work should clarify biomarkers. Remains unknown which circulating markers predict healthspan under interventions.

hits.title: Lifespan extension interventions in mice
hits.abstract_snippet: We survey diet and drug interventions that extend lifespan. Poorly understood how to choose interim healthspan biomarkers with AUROC criteria.

question.question: Can mRNA vaccines induce durable neutralizing antibodies against seasonal influenza?
question.operationalization: Measure neutralizing titers at ≥6 months post-vaccination in ≥2 human cohorts versus standard inactivated vaccine.
question.why_it_matters: Durability determines boost cadence and public-health utility.

hits.title: mRNA influenza vaccine induces durable neutralizing antibodies at 6 months in adults
hits.abstract_snippet: We demonstrate neutralizing titers at ≥6 months post-vaccination in a human cohort after mRNA influenza vaccination versus inactivated vaccine. Results show durable neutralizing antibodies; a second cohort is ongoing.

hits.title: Seasonal influenza vaccine platforms compared for neutralizing titers
hits.abstract_snippet: We compare inactivated and mRNA platforms measuring neutralizing antibodies. Further research is needed on durable titers beyond six months in multiple cohorts.

question.question: What is the optimal divertor material under DEMO-relevant plasma fluxes for commercial fusion?
question.operationalization: Compare candidate materials on erosion, tritium retention, and mechanical lifetime under DEMO-relevant fluxes.
question.why_it_matters: Divertor lifetime is a critical path for fusion commercialization.
